_comment: Mutating routes with no principal guard (requireRole, requireCapability, ...). Each entry needs a category from CATEGORIES in scripts/lib/mutating-route-guards.mjs and a reason verified in the handler. The list may only shrink: lower maxEntries when you remove one. needs-owner-decision is temporary.

server/api/agent-signup.ts::POST /.reason: agent account signup: unauthenticated by design (isAgentPublic); handler enforces the Turnstile bot challenge and validates the body

server/api/agent/login.ts::POST /login.reason: agent sign-in: path is unauthenticated by design (isAgentPublic); the handler checks email and password, same generic 401 for every failure

server/api/agent/login.ts::POST /login-l.reason: agent magic-link request: unauthenticated by design (isAgentPublic); always answers 200 so it cannot enumerate accounts

server/api/agent/magic-login.ts::POST /m.reason: unauthenticated by design (isAgentPublic); the handler requires a live agent-kind report token for the inspection before emailing a link

server/api/agent/report-context.ts::POST.reason: unauthenticated by design (isAgentPublic); read-only probe that resolves a report token via resolvePortalAccess

server/api/agent/terms.ts::POST /accept-.reason: handler throws 401 unless c.get(agentUserId) is set, then records acceptance for that agent only

server/api/auth.ts::POST /change-passwor.reason: own account: handler 401s without user.sub and requires the current password; agents refused centrally

server/api/auth.ts::POST /forgot-passwor.reason: in ANONYMOUS_API_ALLOW: password reset request, sent without a session; handler answers uniformly

server/api/auth.ts::POST /join.reason: in ANONYMOUS_API_ALLOW: accepting an invitation; the invite token is the credential (joinTeam verifies it)

server/api/auth.ts::POST /reset-password.reason: in ANONYMOUS_API_ALLOW: the emailed reset token is the credential (resetPassword verifies it)

server/api/auth.ts::POST /setup.reason: isAuthPublic path; handler refuses with 409 once any tenant user exists and requires the SETUP_CODE secret (fails closed when unset)

server/api/auth/profile.ts::PATCH /profi.reason: own profile: handler 401s without user.sub and updates only the row with id = user.sub; agents are refused centrally (not in AGENT_API_ALLOW)

server/api/auth/profile.ts::POST /logout.reason: in ANONYMOUS_API_ALLOW and AGENT_API_ALLOW: revokes the caller sessions if any and clears the cookie; harmless without a session

server/api/auth/totp.ts::POST /2fa/disab.reason: own account: needs the password and a valid code of that user; agents refused centrally

server/api/auth/totp.ts::POST /2fa/recov.reason: own account: needs the password and a valid code of that user; agents refused centrally

server/api/auth/totp.ts::POST /2fa/setup.reason: own account: loadCurrentUser 401s without user.sub; refuses when 2FA is already enabled; agents refused centrally

server/api/auth/totp.ts::POST /2fa/verif.reason: own account: rate-limited, loadCurrentUser, verifies the code against that user pending secret; agents refused centrally

server/api/bookings/agreement.ts::POST /.reason: public signing page; the presented token resolves to a signer or 404
public signing page; the presented token resolves to a signer (getSignerByPresentedToken) or 404

server/api/bookings/create.ts::POST /boo.reason: public booking form: rate-limited, resolves the company from the submitted slug and validates the body

server/api/calendar.ts::DELETE /disconne.reason: acts only on the caller's own calendar connection (user.sub); agents are refused centrally by api-access-policy; staff cannot be assigned jobs so a connected calendar exposes nothing. Decision 2026-10-16: no role gate (keep it minimal); add requireRole to every route in calendar.ts if that changes

server/api/calendar.ts::POST /sync.reason: acts only on the caller's own calendar connection (user.sub); agents are refused centrally by api-access-policy; same decision as DELETE /disconnect (2026-10-16)

server/api/calendar.ts::PUT /connections.reason: the handler requires the connection to be the caller's own (loadOpenCalendarConnection by user.sub); agents are refused centrally by api-access-policy; same decision as DELETE /disconnect (2026-10-16)

server/api/client-documents.ts::DELETE /.reason: mounted at /api/public; resolveClientActor grant required, and only the uploader (uploadedByRef) may delete

server/api/client-documents.ts::PUT /ins.reason: mounted at /api/public; resolveClientActor requires a client grant (token or portal session) for the inspection, else 401

server/api/concierge.ts::POST /confirm.reason: isConciergePublic: the magic-link token is the credential (confirmByClient verifies it)

server/api/identity.ts::POST /account/de.reason: /api/identities/ is in AGENT_API_ALLOW by policy: any signed-in identity deletes its own account after confirming its email

server/api/identity.ts::POST /account/ex.reason: /api/identities/ is in AGENT_API_ALLOW by policy: any signed-in identity exports its own data (user id from the session)

server/api/mcp-grants.ts::DELETE /grants.reason: self path revokes only the caller own grant; the admin path (?admin=1) checks owner or manager inline before touching another member grant

server/api/messages-client-routes.ts::PO.reason: mounted at /api/public; resolveClientActor grant required, then a client seat on the inspection (403 otherwise)

server/api/messages.ts::POST /inspection.reason: mounted at /api/public; resolveClientActor grant required, 401 otherwise

server/api/notification-preferences.ts::.reason: own preferences: keyed by the session user id; agents have their own route under /api/agent
own preferences: subject is the session user
own SMS consent: subject is the session user

server/api/notifications.ts::DELETE /{id.reason: own notices: requireUserId and the archive is scoped to that user

server/api/notifications.ts::POST /mark-.reason: own notices: requireUserId and scoped to that user
own notices: requireUserId (401 without a session) and every write is scoped to that user

server/api/portal.ts::POST /{tenant}/log.reason: /api/portal/ is public: only clears the portal cookie; idempotent and tenant-agnostic

server/api/portal.ts::POST /{tenant}/req.reason: /api/portal/ is public: asks for a sign-in link by email; answers uniformly whether or not the address has access

server/api/profile.ts::PATCH /.reason: own profile: handler 401s without user.sub and updates only that user row; agents refused centrally

server/api/profile.ts::POST /photo.reason: own profile photo: handler 401s without user.sub and stores under that user key; agents refused centrally

server/api/public-report.ts::POST /inspe.reason: resolveClientActor: client or co-client grant required (401 otherwise); refuses a tenant mismatch

server/api/public-share.ts::POST /inspec.reason: requires an existing access proof for this inspection (portal token or agent-view bridge), else 404

server/api/public/deposit-intent.ts::POS.reason: /api/public/ prefix: a client paying a booking deposit before any account; rate-limited, refuses once the visit is under way

server/api/csp-report.ts::POST /csp-repo.reason: /api/public/csp-report: browser CSP violation reports are sent without credentials; the handler does no database, KV, R2, email or queue work, reads at most 16 KiB, logs a sampled line and always answers 204 (the middleware chain still runs; a non-204 just drops the report)

server/api/public/uploads.ts::POST /uplo.reason: verifyUploadToken: signed single-purpose upload token required (401 otherwise); destination re-checked
verifyUploadToken: signed single-purpose upload token required (401 otherwise); destination re-checked

server/api/public/video-chunked.ts::POST.reason: verifyUploadToken: signed single-purpose upload token required (401 otherwise); issuer re-checked as an active member; upload row read by the token's own tenant and media id

server/api/public/video-chunked.ts::PUT.reason: verifyUploadToken: signed single-purpose upload token required (401 otherwise); issuer re-checked as an active member; upload row read by the token's own tenant and media id

server/api/public/video-chunked.ts::POST.reason: verifyUploadToken: signed single-purpose upload token required (401 otherwise); issuer re-checked as an active member; upload row read by the token's own tenant and media id

server/api/public/video-chunked.ts::DELE.reason: verifyUploadToken: signed single-purpose upload token required (401 otherwise); issuer re-checked as an active member; upload row read by the token's own tenant and media id

server/api/public/view-tracking.ts::POST.reason: resolvePortalRecipient: a portal access token for the inspection is required (401 otherwise)

server/api/qbo-webhook.ts::POST /.reason: /webhooks/ prefix: 401 without intuit-signature; verifies the HMAC over the raw body

server/api/repair-builder/crud-routes.ts.reason: resolveBuilderAccess credential required; only the creator may remove (403 otherwise)
resolveBuilderAccess credential required; only the creator may edit (403 otherwise)
/repair-builder/ is token-track: resolveBuilderAccess requires a valid access credential (401 otherwise) and a published report

server/api/repair-builder/share.ts::POST.reason: /repair-request/ is token-track: the share token in the path is the credential and the report must be published

server/api/sms.ts::POST /sms/inbound/:te.reason: /webhooks/ prefix: verifies the provider signature with the company own secret before acting

server/api/sms.ts::POST /sms/optin-confi.reason: resolveOptinToken: the sealed opt-in token is the credential (404 when invalid or expired)

server/api/stripe-webhook.ts::POST /.reason: /webhooks/ prefix: 401 without stripe-signature; verifies it with the company webhook secret

server/api/test-hooks.ts::POST /calendar.reason: /api/__test__/ is a public prefix; handler answers 404 unless E2E_EMAIL_SINK === 1 (absent flag, no route)

server/api/test-hooks.ts::POST /report-t.reason: /api/__test__/ is a public prefix; handler answers 404 unless E2E_EMAIL_SINK === 1 (absent flag, no route)

server/api/unsubscribe.ts::POST /unsubsc.reason: /api/public/ prefix: the signed unsubscribe token is the credential (resolveLink)

server/api/users.ts::POST /me/onboarding.reason: own onboarding flags: handler 401s without user.sub and writes only that user row; agents refused centrally

server/api/widget.ts::POST /event.reason: /api/public/widget: embeddable widget analytics; silently drops events from origins the company has not allowed
